newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Stahl does not rule out dividend cut.
newsitem.headline: VA Stahl does not rule out dividend cut.

text.p: Austrian steel maker VA Stahl said on Friday it could not rule out cutting the 1996 dividend from last year's 13 schillings per share.

"We will keep our basic dividend at 10 (schillings) and distribute an additional bonus payment. I can't say today whether this bonus will be three (schillings) as it was last year," chief executive Peter Strahammer told a news conference without elaborating further.

Strahammer declined to give a detailed forecast for the full-year result, but said it would be "slightly better than in 1994", when the company reported pre-tax earnings of 1.32 billion schillings and a net profit of 645 million.

VA Stahl earlier on Friday said pretax profit in the first six months of the year fell to 1.33 billion schillings from 1.94 billion a year ago and predicted a further decline for the second half of the year. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
